It hurts when I swallow, both solids and liquids, but I don’t feel like something is stuck in my throat.

I’m not sure if the lymph nodes are swollen or tender. My main issue is the throat pain and sensitivity.

I’m not sure about white patches or pus or any coating. I haven’t looked closely at my throat, and I don’t know what it looks like on exam.

I am coughing, but I haven’t noticed or checked sputum color or consistency. I can’t say what it looks like.
